tool_input.command:
cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql --no-verify --schema mlpab9615df_featurestore --limit 5 --json "
SELECT r.request_id,
       r.account_id,
       ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6) AS distance_deg,
       ROUND(p.base_score - 0.1 * ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6), 6) AS score
FROM requests_raw_1 r
JOIN profiles_raw_1 p ON r.account_id = p.account_id
ORDER BY r.request_id" 2>&1 | tail -40
cd "$(pwd)" && hops trino catalogs --json --no-verify 2>&1 | tail -20

cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql --no-verify --catalog hive --schema mlpab9615df_featurestore --limit 5 --json "
SELECT r.request_id,
       r.account_id,
       ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6) AS distance_deg,
       ROUND(p.base_score - 0.1 * ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6), 6) AS score
FROM requests_raw_1 r
JOIN profiles_raw_1 p ON r.account_id = p.account_id
ORDER BY r.request_id" 2>&1 | tail -40

cd "$(pwd)" && hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab9615df_featurestore --limit 5 --json "
SELECT r.request_id,
       r.account_id,
       ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6) AS distance_deg,
       ROUND(p.base_score - 0.1 * ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6), 6) AS score
FROM requests_raw_1 r
JOIN profiles_raw_1 p ON r.account_id = p.account_id
ORDER BY r.request_id" 2>&1 | tail -40

cd "$(pwd)" && hops fg create scored26cb88 --version 1 \
  --primary-key request_id --online \
  --features "request_id:string,account_id:string,distance_deg:double,score:double" \
  --description "On-demand distance/score features per scoring request" --json 2>&1 | tail -8

SELECT r.request_id,
